reason: The dense knot and nearby cold cloud seem like the clearest route to testing whether the surviving clumps can form stars.
expectation: The gas may gather further and form new stars, though it could require another step.

alternatives.reason: The young stars might illuminate or change the inherited dust, but I want to follow the surviving clumps first.

effect: The surviving clumps helped form new stars, completing that goal; I can now follow the dust.
reaction: It is satisfying to see the old pillars contribute to new lights beyond the galaxy's edge.
reason: The young stars may show what happens to dust that remains in their light.
expectation: Their radiation may heat or illuminate the dust, though its fate is uncertain.

alternatives.reason: The outflow could carry dust away, but I want to follow the illuminated dust first.

effect: The dust absorbs starlight and reradiates it in infrared; the remaining goal suggests following dust carried outward.
reaction: The distinction between glowing gas and warmed grains is interesting.
reason: Combining the outflow with dusty gas directly follows the other dust path described in the chapter.
expectation: The outflow may carry some dust away from the nursery, though its eventual fate is unclear.

alternatives.reason: The warmed dust could also enter the outflow, but I want to follow the unheated dusty gas first.

effect: The outflow carries dust outward, with some grains sheltered and others exposed; the next step follows it into the outer gas.
reaction: The different degrees of shelter make the dust's journey more interesting.
reason: This is the only available combination and may show the dust's fate in the hot outer gas.
expectation: The dust will encounter the hot outer gas and may disperse or change, though its fate is uncertain.

effect: The hot outer gas erodes many dust grains, completing the inherited-dust goal and the chapter.
reaction: It is striking that material can return to the gas after the grains are destroyed.

mostWorthwhile.text: Following the surviving clumps into new stars was satisfying because it connected the old pillars to new lights beyond the nursery.

leastWorthwhile.text: Carrying the dust outward was a fairly predictable intermediate step, though the distinction between sheltered and exposed grains added some interest.

surprise.text: Warmed dust radiates in infrared, while grains carried into hot outer gas can later be eroded; warming does not protect them.

arbitrary.text: No action felt clearly purposeless, though the fast menu offered compatible combinations rather than requiring me to discover them.

continue.text: Yes. I would be interested to follow how the dispersed material encounters other clouds, though this chapter's dust journey reached a satisfying stopping point.
